findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_llc_fees, get_annual_report_deadline · Private data: list_filing_states, submit_order · Public sink: preview_order, submit_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_llc_fees, get_annual_report_deadline · Private data: list_filing_states, submit_order · Public sink: preview_order, submit_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
